assumptions.successLoad: Exactly one successful catch per active angler-hour; a stress input, not a measured probability result.
assumptions.captureAllocation: Fully mixed pond; weight per fish = quality candidate weight × current shared single-fish bite rate × bamboo rod multiplier × pond bite multiplier × (1 - rod-adjusted escape rate × pond escape multiplier).
assumptions.stock: Actual shared opening/mixed growth, original category/species pool, hourly <=40 to80, Shanghai04:00 to100, strict high-quality cap.
assumptions.shifts: 5/20 continuously active seats require 15/60 users in three 8-hour shifts per day. Scenarios are alternatives, not simultaneous demands on one 100-user line.
assumptions.referenceRate: Bamboo rod + free basic bait + spot multiplier1, 60 independent checks/hour, no busy time. Theoretical success opportunities, not observed catch throughput.
